subject: SFDC: horizon clean & decommit guidance for Greenline Health
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Fri, 28 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SFDC: horizon clean & decommit guidance for Greenline Health

Team — quick note ahead of week-close. Finance asked us to clean up anything that looks like a soft commit in the current close window so forecast numbers are actionable. I pulled a short list of Greenline Health opportunities that are skewing our commit: see attached flagged-opps-may28.csv.

Ask: please take the actions below by EOD Tuesday (6/1):
- Verify the true customer intent for each opp in the CSV and update Stage to one of: Commit / Commit - At Risk / No Go.
- If no substantive buyer activity in 30+ days and no upcoming meeting, decommit (move to Closed - Lost or reclass to Prospect).
- If customer confirmed but needs paperwork or final pricing, set Close Date to the realistic quarter and add a <last_touch> note summarizing next step.

Three specific opps I flagged as higher priority:
- GL-2027-ACQ (Account expansion) — last activity 4/14; there was a demo but no pricing discussion.
- GL-2027-ANNUAL (renewal upsell) — procurement looped in; proposal sent 5/10, DocuSign pending.
- GL-2026-ENG (pilot) — stalled, no touch in 45 days; currently in Commit in SFDC.

If you want Finance to approve any short-term credit/terms to preserve commit, note it inline and cc: finance-ops. Otherwise we should be conservative and decommit where appropriate — we can't have phantom commit inflate next quarter.

Attachment: flagged-opps-may28.csv (columns: deal_id,owner,last_touch,stage,close_date,notes)

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Maria Lopez <maria@greenlinehealth.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SFDC: horizon clean & decommit guidance for Greenline Health

Thanks for the pull, Ben — digging in and here's my read + proposed actions (per-opportunity):

1) GL-2027-ACQ — Recommendation: Push out close date to 2027-08-15 and set Stage = Commit - At Risk.
  - Last activity: discovery call 2027-04-14.
  - Next step: pricing workshop requested; Maria offered to schedule pricing week of 6/14.
  - Notes to add: "Customer requested detailed TCO; pricing workshop pending w/ procurement."
  - Rationale: There's momentum but paperwork timeline pushes beyond current close window. Not a decommit yet.

2) GL-2027-ANNUAL — Recommendation: Keep as Commit but update Close Date to 2027-06-22 and push DocuSign link; cc'd procurement (procurement@greenlinehealth.com).
  - Proposal sent 2027-05-10; DocuSign shows awaiting signature (link attached).
  - Action: I'll follow-up with Maria tomorrow and confirm signature ETA.

3) GL-2026-ENG — Recommendation: Decommit and move to Closed - Lost (requalification tag: "pilot-stalled").
  - No touch since 2027-03-18; multiple outreach attempts.
  - Reason: pilot didn't surface ROI use-case; customer deprioritized.
  - Action: archive collateral and note requalification next quarter.

I attached an updated MA plan (greenline-ma-plan-v2.pdf) with pricing alternatives if they ask for a discount extension. If Finance needs to approve any credit for GL-2027-ANNUAL to keep within this quarter, flag it now.

On the SFDC side I'll: update Stage and Close Date fields, add the note snippets above, and tag the records with "forecast-hygiene-202705".

Ben — once I push these changes, do you want me to open the decommit for GL-2026-ENG now or wait until you get a final prod response from your champion?

--
Lauren Bishop
Senior AE, Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Cc: finance-ops <finance-ops@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SFDC: horizon clean & decommit guidance for Greenline Health

Agree with Lauren's recommendations. Finance reviewed the quick case and will: 
- Approve decommit for GL-2026-ENG (we'll mark as Closed - Lost and remove from commit) — no credit required.
- For GL-2027-ANNUAL, finance OK to hold proposed pricing as-is for 10 business days while we get DocuSign completed. If customer requests extended credit/discount, we'll need a short approval note and business justification.

Lauren — please execute the SFDC updates and tag finance-ops once done. Ben — once you confirm GL-2027-ACQ scheduling (pricing workshop), we'll re-evaluate whether a limited-term extension is warranted.

Attachment: decommit-approval-20270602.pdf

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Sales Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com
